about: Synthetic test life no. 2 for the memory-structure bake-off (2026-10-31). Fictional person, every fact invented; no owner data. Messages are what the person says to Jarvis, in date order, in English, Tamil and Tanglish. Questions are asked 'today' = 2026-10-31. Scoring is the same as test_life.json: an answer passes when every group in 'must' has at least one alternative in the answer (case-insensitive) and no 'must_not' term appears; 'abstain' questions pass only when the answer says it doesn't know and states no value. Alternatives of 3 characters or fewer match as whole words only. Kinds as in test_life.json plus 'connected' (needs two facts said far apart) and 'old_fact' (said once, more than six months before today, never repeated). 'gold' is a right answer and 'traps' are wrong answers that must fail; the runner ignores both (scripts/check_memory_eval_data.py checks them).

messages.text: Hi Jarvis! I'm Kavitha Murugesan. My friends call me Kavi.
I live in a rented flat in K.K. Nagar, Madurai, with my husband Senthil, our daughter Nila and our son Ilan.
Senthil (Senthilkumar on paper) is a site engineer at L&T Construction.
Nila is 6 and in class 1 at Sri Vidya Mandir. Her birthday is 12 June.
Ilan was born on 27 January 2024. At home we call him Kutty.
En amma peru Mahalakshmi. Naan avangala 'Ma'nu dhaan kooppiduven, avanga friends ellarum 'Maha'nu kooppiduvanga.
Ma and Appa live in Palayamkottai, Tirunelveli. Appa, Subramanian, is a retired headmaster.
I work at Velan Infotech in Madurai as a QA lead. I've been there since 2019.
My project at Velan is MediBill, a hospital billing app. I lead a team of five testers.
My manager at Velan is Prakash.
My side business is Nila Pickles: homemade pickles and podis that I sell through WhatsApp and Instagram.
The heart of Nila Pickles is Ma's narthangai (citron) pickle recipe. I learnt it from her.
I play badminton every Tuesday evening at the Gandhi Nagar indoor court.
Sorry, I said Tuesday, I meant Thursday. Badminton is on Thursday evenings.
My phone is a Redmi Note 12. Senthil uses a Vivo V29 and rides a Bajaj Pulsar.
En blood group O negative, adhanala blood donation camp-ku eppavum ennai kooppiduvanga.
I don't drink coffee at all. I'm a ginger tea person.
My birthday is 18 March.
Senthil got me a silver anklet for my birthday today.
My best friend from college is Deepa Sekar. She runs a boutique called Deepa Designs on Town Hall Road, Madurai.
Thursday night badminton mudichittu late-ah dhaan veetuku varuven, so andha naal dinner Senthil dhaan seivaaru.
Our car is a Maruti Baleno. The SBI car loan EMI is 11,500 rupees on the 10th of every month.
For short trips I ride my Honda Activa.
I'm lactose intolerant, so I avoid milk. Curd is fine for me though.
Senthil's amma, Pushpa, lives in her own house in Anna Nagar, Madurai.
Started an SIP of 5,000 rupees a month in the Navarasa Flexi Cap fund.
I also pay 3,000 a month into a gold savings scheme at Kanaga Jewellers.
Our rent in K.K. Nagar is 14,000 a month.
Back from Rameswaram: three days, for Ma's prayer at the temple. Ilan loved the beach.
My brother Arun lives in Pune and works as a data engineer at Zentrix Systems.
Arun just switched to a OnePlus 13. He keeps telling me to get one too, but I'm not buying it.
Our neighbour Revathi in K.K. Nagar teaches chemistry at Madurai Kamaraj University.
Nila Pickles got its FSSAI registration today!
Ma has thyroid; she takes a Thyronorm tablet every morning.
I joined a pottery class at Mann Studio on Saturday mornings.
Thinking about learning Hindi, maybe next year. Not sure yet.
Senthil plays cricket on Sundays with his office team.
My dentist is Dr. Farhana at Pearl Smile Clinic on Bypass Road, Madurai.
Nila turned 7 today! Cake, balloons, the full drama.
Nila moved up to class 2 at Sri Vidya Mandir this week.
நிலாவுக்கு கணக்கு பாடம் ரொம்ப பிடிக்கும்.
Indha maasam Nila Pickles-ku 120 orders vandhuchu!
Deepa, my college friend, wants to stock Nila Pickles in her boutique. We're trying it from August.
I don't eat non-veg on Saturdays.
Thinking of switching jobs. Velan hasn't given appraisals for two years.
Bought a new phone: a Samsung Galaxy S24. My old Redmi went to Ma.
For personal stuff I use a MacBook Air M2; at work I have a Dell Latitude.
Senthil's anna Murali lives in Dubai and works as an electrician.
என் அப்பா தினமும் காலையில 5 மணிக்கு எழுந்து நடக்கப் போவார்.
Today is our 10th wedding anniversary!
Oru vishayam: Lakshmi from my college batch works at Thenral Systems in Coimbatore. Avanga QA manager role-ku aal edukkuraanga-nu sonnaanga.
Ma's knee pain is worse; Appa is taking her to Dr. Selvaraj at Tirunelveli Medical College.
Interview at Thenral Systems went well. Second round next week.
Got the offer! Senior QA Manager at Thenral Systems in Coimbatore. Lakshmi referred me. I join on 2 February 2026.
Senthil has asked L&T for a transfer to Coimbatore.
I stopped the pottery classes. Saturdays are too packed with pickle orders.
Deepavali orders were crazy: 300 jars of pickle in two weeks.
It's Senthil's birthday today. Got him a Noise smartwatch.
Senthil's transfer came through: from February he'll be on the Coimbatore airport expansion project.
எனக்கு மல்லிகைப்பூவை விட கனகாம்பரம் தான் ரொம்ப பிடிக்கும்.
We've decided to stop shipping Nila Pickles outside Tamil Nadu. Too many glass jars broke in the courier.
Ilan has a mild wheeze. His paediatrician, Dr. Anand, gave him an inhaler.
Found a flat in Saibaba Colony, Coimbatore. Rent is 22,000 a month. We move on 25 January.
What's the weather in Coimbatore this week?
Last day at Velan Infotech today. The MediBill team took me out for a farewell lunch.
Moved! We now live in Saibaba Colony, Coimbatore.
Ilan turned 2 today.
First day at Thenral Systems. My manager is Deepa Iyer.
Funny, two Deepas in my life now: Deepa Iyer is my boss, and Deepa Sekar is still my friend with the boutique in Madurai.
At Thenral I'm in charge of testing AgriSense, a crop-insurance platform. We use Playwright and k6.
Nila joined class 2 at Kovai Public School.
Ilan goes to Little Steps daycare near our flat.
Senthil started on the airport expansion project this week.
Increased my SIP to 8,000 a month with the new salary.
No wait, I made it 9,000, not 8,000.
Joined the Saibaba Colony Shuttle Club. Badminton is on Sunday mornings now, no more Thursdays.
There's another Kavitha on my team, Kavitha Raman, a junior tester. Everyone calls her KR to avoid confusion.
Birthday today; the team at Thenral surprised me with a cake.
Ma and Appa are visiting us in Coimbatore for two weeks.
Nila Pickles now delivers across Coimbatore too, and Deepa Sekar still stocks it in her Madurai boutique.
Deepa Iyer uses an iPhone 16 Pro and keeps sending me AirDrop requests I can't accept.
Maybe I'll join a gym near Saibaba Colony. Haven't decided.
Thanks Jarvis!
Nila Pickles started on 1 May 2023, so three years today!
Summer holidays: Nila is at Ma's place in Palayamkottai for two weeks.
Closed the gold scheme at Kanaga Jewellers; their Madurai branch is too far now.
இலன் இப்போ 'அம்மா', 'தாத்தா'ன்னு பேச ஆரம்பிச்சிட்டான்.
Nila is in class 3 now.
Nila turned 8 today.
Arun married Swathi in Pune last week. She's a physiotherapist.
Ilan's new paediatrician in Coimbatore is Dr. Shanthi at Kidz Care. She says his wheeze is better and he can stop the inhaler.
KR bought a TVS Jupiter scooter.
Narthangai pickle is still our bestseller, around 40 jars a month.
Deepa Iyer kooda ippo ennai Kavi-nu dhaan kooppidraanga; office-la ellarukkum naan Kavi dhaan.
Senthil sold his Pulsar and bought a Royal Enfield Hunter 350.
I've been thinking about selling Nila Pickles on Amazon. Maybe after Deepavali.
From today I also lead QA for Thenral's new product, KisanPay.
Senthil-ku kaaram konjam kooda pidikkadhu, aana enakku nalla kaaram dhaan venum.
Deepa Iyer worked at Zoho for eight years before she joined Thenral.
Took up watercolour painting: an online class with Ms. Rekha every Wednesday night.
Correction: Ms. Rekha's class is on Friday nights, not Wednesday.
11th anniversary today. Dinner at Kovai Vilas.
Swapped my Samsung S24 for a Pixel 10. The Samsung went to Senthil.
Ma's thyroid tests came back normal.
I've stopped taking sugar in my tea.
Nila wants to learn Bharatanatyam, so we enrolled her at Natya Kala Academy. Classes are on Tuesdays and Saturdays.
என் காரை ஸ்ரீ கணேஷ் மோட்டார்ஸ்ல தான் சர்வீஸ் பண்ணுவேன்.
Lakshmi, the friend who referred me, has moved to Bangalore for a job at Brightloop.
Planning the December holiday: maybe Ooty, maybe Yercaud.
Can you set a timer for 10 minutes?
Booked a cottage in Yercaud from 20 to 23 December.
For Deepavali (8 November) we're going to Palayamkottai, 6 to 9 November.
Nila Pickles Deepavali pre-orders: 180 jars so far.
I don't use Instagram for Nila Pickles anymore; WhatsApp brings most of the orders.
Arun and Swathi might visit us at Christmas, not confirmed.
Remind me: Nila's school PTA meeting is on 14 November.
Ma-ku next month 65 vayasu aagudhu; avanga birthday 30 November.
Senthil's airport project finishes next March. L&T may move him to Chennai after that, nothing confirmed.
